latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Stock Watcher Skill:

- Manage your personal stock watchlist: add, remove, list, or clear stocks by code.
- View a concise performance summary for all watchlist stocks, including key indicators and quick links.
- Real-time data sourced from 同花顺 (10jqka.com.cn); supports沪深A股 and 科创板 stocks.
- Stores watchlist in a user directory for easy management.
- Includes install/uninstall scripts and robust error/network handling.
